name: inbox.clear_noise
description: Clears all the noise at once: messages marked noise, and emoji-only ones with no letter or digit.
sql: with cleared as (update brandbase.inbox_messages m set done_at = :now::timestamptz where m.brand_id = :brand and m.done_at is null and (m.tone = 'noise' or not textfn.has_word(m.text)) returning m.id) select jsonb_build_object('cleared', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(id order by id) from cleared), '[]')) as result
